_meta.indication: SPRYCEL is indicated for adults with chronic, accelerated, or myeloid or lymphoid blast phase CML with resistance or intolerance to prior therapy including imatinib, and for adults with Philadelphia chromosome-positive acute lymphoblastic leukemia (Ph+ ALL) with resistance or intolerance to prior therapy.

pivotal_trials.trial_name: CA-180-015, a phase 2 multicenter study of dasatinib in Lymphoid Blast Phase CML or Ph+ ALL
pivotal_trials.design: Single-arm, open-label multicenter study; all patients treated with dasatinib 70 mg BID continuously
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with lymphoid blast phase CML/Ph+ ALL resistant to or intolerant of imatinib
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was major hematologic response (MaHR), defined as complete hematologic response or no evidence of leukemia
pivotal_trials.n: 78 patients in the lymphoid blast phase CML/Ph+ ALL study (lymphoid blast n=42, Ph+ ALL n=36)
pivotal_trials.result: MaHR was 31% (95% CI 18-47) in lymphoid blast phase CML and 42% (95% CI 26-59) in Ph+ ALL; median duration of MaHR 3.7 months in lymphoid blast CML and 4.8 months in Ph+ ALL

pivotal_trials.design: Single-arm, open-label; dasatinib 70 mg BID continuously
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with chronic phase CML resistant to or intolerant of imatinib
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was major cytogenetic response (MCyR)
pivotal_trials.result: MCyR rate 45% with complete response (0% Ph+ cells) rate of 33%

pivotal_trials.design: Single-arm, open-label; dasatinib 70 mg BID continuously
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with accelerated phase CML resistant to or intolerant of imatinib
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was major hematologic response (MaHR), defined as complete hematologic response or no evidence of leukemia
pivotal_trials.result: MaHR rate 59% (95% CI 49-68) in accelerated phase patients

pivotal_trials.trial_name: Myeloid blast phase CML single-arm study
pivotal_trials.design: Single-arm, open-label; dasatinib 70 mg BID continuously
pivotal_trials.population: Adults with myeloid blast phase CML resistant to or intolerant of imatinib
pivotal_trials.endpoint: Primary endpoint was major hematologic response (MaHR), defined as complete hematologic response or no evidence of leukemia
pivotal_trials.result: MaHR rate 32% (95% CI 22-44) in myeloid blast phase patients

key_safety: Most common adverse events (≥10%) included fluid retention (50%), diarrhea (49%), headache (40%), hemorrhage (40%), musculoskeletal pain (39%), pyrexia (39%), fatigue (39%). Serious toxicities include severe (Grade 3/4) myelosuppression — neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, anemia — more frequent in advanced CML/Ph+ ALL, and bleeding events (severe CNS hemorrhage in 1%, severe GI hemorrhage in 7%).
target_moa: Dasatinib is an inhibitor of multiple tyrosine kinases; at nanomolar concentrations it inhibits BCR-ABL, SRC family kinases (SRC, LCK, YES, FYN), c-KIT, EPHA2, and PDGFRβ, and can overcome imatinib resistance from BCR-ABL kinase domain mutations.

summary.text: SPRYCEL (NDA 22-072) was submitted December 28, 2005 and approved June 28, 2006 based on hematologic and cytogenetic response rates from four single-arm multicenter studies; the label notes there are no controlled trials demonstrating a clinical benefit such as improved survival, and three postmarketing study commitments were made at approval.

citations.quote: Please refer to your new drug application (NDA) dated December 28, 2005, received December 28, 2005, submitted under section 505(b) of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act for SPRYCEL™ (dasatinib) Tablets.

The effectiveness of SPRYCEL is based on hematologic and cytogenetic response rates (see **CLINICAL STUDIES**). There are no controlled trials demonstrating a clinical benefit, such as improvement in disease-related symptoms or increased survival.
We remind you of your postmarketing study commitments in your submission dated June 27, 2006. These commitments are listed below.

requirement.text: Submit the complete study report (24 month follow-up) and data from study CA-180-015, a phase 2 multicenter study of dasatinib in Lymphoid Blast Phase CML or Ph+ ALL resistant/intolerant to imatinib (final report submission 06/2008).

citations.quote: You have agreed to submit the complete study report (24 month follow-up) and data from the study, CA-180-015, a phase 2 multicenter study of dasatinib (BMS-354825) in subjects with Lymphoid Blast Phase Chronic Myeloid Leukemia or Philadelphia Chromosome Positive Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia resistant to high dose Imatinib Mesylate (Gleevec) or who are intolerant of Imatinib Mesylate.

requirement.text: Submit the complete study report and data from study CA-180-051, a single-dose pharmacokinetic study of BMS-354825 in subjects with hepatic impairment compared to healthy adult subjects (final report submission 01/2009).

citations.quote: You have agreed to submit the complete study report and data from the study, CA-180-051, a single-dose, pharmacokinetic study of BMS-354825 in subjects with hepatic impairment compared to healthy adult subjects.

requirement.text: Submit the complete study report and data from study CA-180-021, an open-label single-sequence study of the effect of ketoconazole on the pharmacokinetics of BMS-354825 in patients with advanced solid tumors (final report submission 12/2006).
